story.iWant: to answer 4-7 simple profiling questions presented in a conversational flow
story.soThat: the quiz feels tailored to my needs without being overwhelming

subtask.description: Import getStartingQuestion and getQuestionById from src/lib/profiling/questions.ts.
Use a Svelte state variable to hold the current question object.
Initialize the component by calling getStartingQuestion() to load the first question.
Render the text of the current question.
Use an #each block to render a button for each answer in the answers array.
Create an on:click handler for the answer buttons.
In the handler, get the next_question_id from the selected answer.
Call getQuestionById() with the next_question_id to get the next question.
Update the state variable to render the new question.
Handle the end of the quiz flow when next_question_id is undefined.
Use TailwindCSS and DaisyUI classes for a clean, mobile-responsive layout.
Ensure the component is easy to use on both mobile and desktop screens.
Create a Playwright test file for the profiling quiz flow.
Write a test that simulates a user clicking through a complete path of the question tree.
Assert that the correct questions are displayed based on the selected answers.

acceptanceCriteria.ac: A Svelte component renders profiling questions dynamically.
Navigation between questions is smooth and based on user answers.
The UI is clean, mobile-responsive, and easy to use.

artifact.reason: Example of an existing Svelte component in the project, demonstrating component structure and basic Svelte usage.
Defines the data structures for profiling questions and answers, which this UI component will render.
Contains the actual profiling question data and helper functions for navigating the question tree, essential for the UI's logic.

constraint.description: The UI component must be implemented using Svelte.
Styling must adhere to TailwindCSS and DaisyUI conventions for consistency and mobile responsiveness.
The new Svelte component should be created in `src/lib/components/profiling/`.
The component must utilize the `ProfilingQuestion` interface and helper functions (`getStartingQuestion`, `getQuestionById`) from `src/lib/profiling/` for question data and navigation logic.
The UI should present questions in a conversational flow, avoiding overwhelming the user with too much information at once.

interface.name: getStartingQuestion
interface.reason: Function to retrieve the initial profiling question to start the quiz flow.

interface.name: getQuestionById
interface.reason: Function to retrieve a specific profiling question by its ID, used for navigating the question tree.

interface.name: ProfilingQuestion
interface.reason: The data structure that the UI component will render.

tests.standards: End-to-end tests should be written using Playwright. Test files should be placed in the `e2e/` directory. Focus on simulating user interactions and asserting correct UI behavior and navigation through the profiling quiz flow.

ideas.idea: Write an end-to-end test that navigates through a complete path of the profiling question tree, asserting that each question and its answers are rendered correctly and that navigation proceeds as expected based on user selections.
Write an end-to-end test to verify the mobile responsiveness of the `ProfilingQuiz.svelte` component across different viewport sizes.
